acceptance: Every caller passes the read set or the parameter becomes required; a test fails if a withdrawal citing an unread path is accepted on any path.
description: #3836 made withdrawal_cited require the cited path in the reviewer's read set, but only the runner passes it (protocol.py:608). report.py:349 and the other callers (attempts.py, protocol.contradiction) call it without a read set, so there it only checks that some citation exists. That is safe today only because mark_citations has already demoted unread withdrawals before those callers run; a reordering would silently accept an uncited withdrawal.
